Sara — thanks for sending this and for the great conversation today.

High level response: we can consider an exception but will need VP/CFO sign-off for anything approaching the discount you suggested. A short summary of the proposed carveout I'm escalating:

- Proposed pilot concession: 40% list discount for the 8-week pilot (not 60%), plus a one-time onboarding credit sized to offset migration effort (~$25k).
- Packaging: private deployment (VPC + dedicated pool) — we can stand this up but operational overhead will reduce the allowable discount.
- Condition: Argentis commits to a post-pilot 24-month contract with a minimum committed spend (we propose a 12-month minimum spend equal to 4x pilot run-rate, and a 24-month tiered rate schedule thereafter).
- Deliverables/guardrails: SOC2 evidence, dedicated onboarding window, two scheduled uptime maintenance windows/month, KPIs for model latency and availability; if KPIs are met we convert to committed terms.

I believe this is a strategic reference opportunity — Argentis is a strong name in cardiology imaging and a case study would be valuable for our enterprise motion. I'm copying Marissa for commercial sign-off and Kimberly to validate margin impact and timeline to CFO.

Request: Marissa / Kimberly — I've included a brief outline below that I'd like to convert into an exec exception memo for VP/CFO review. If we can get approval by end of day Thursday we can respond to Argentis with firm terms and a redlined term-sheet.

- Upside: with a 24-month conversion and case study, expected ARR > $850k over 24 months (conservative estimate).
